category_title: Children with expressive language difficulties and Sotos Syndrome who use persistent, roundabout communication strategies
scenario_title: Everyday routine request with unclear pronunciation
minimal_context: Maliha is sitting at the meal table during lunch time trying to request garlic bread while eating other items.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is lunch time, please eat your food.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Trying to say something while her mouth is full) Aaaii Gaa …bee.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Stutters and repeats sounds, appearing to struggle to find appropriate words to express herself)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: I don't understand what you are saying.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Trying to say something while her mouth is full) Gai …kb e …eed.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: It is lunch time, please eat your food.

STUDENT: (Trying to say something while her mouth is full) Aaaii Gaa …bee.

TUTOR: What do you want?

STUDENT: (Stutters and repeats sounds, appearing to struggle to find appropriate words to express herself)

TUTOR: I don't understand what you are saying.

STUDENT: (Trying to say something while her mouth is full) Gai …kb e …eed.

task.content: Attempting to request garlic bread while eating other items

context.materials: Garlic bread, fish fingers, chicken nuggets, potato chips, vegetable rolls
context.social_setting: Around the child, some other children were served garlic bread

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: Trying to say something while her mouth was full and pronunciation was not clear enough

behavior_patterns.condition: When pronunciations of some words are not clear enough
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Stutters and repeats words and sounds during communications
